in_scope_items.title: Per-session model persistence + model indicator in status bar
acceptance_points: Per-session model persistence — model survives session leave/return
Model indicator displayed in status bar to LEFT of yolo chip
Manual-only changes — only GUI dropdown action changes the model
interaction_steps: Open model dropdown in AgentInput
Pick a non-default model (e.g. haiku 4.5)
Send a short ack message
Navigate to home / sidebar root
Re-enter the same session
Inspect chip text and position vs yolo chip
in_scope_items.success_check: Chip text after re-entry equals chip text before; localStorage 'mmkv.default\\session-model-modes' has entry keyed by session id with picked model value; on both viewports, model chip x-coord < yolo chip x-coord on same y-row.

in_scope_items.title: 1M-context Claude models — context-usage display
acceptance_points: All 1M Claude variants must display non-degenerate context-usage %
Status bar 'N% left' must reflect real token usage (not 0%, not stuck 100%)
Behaviour parity with non-1M Claude models
interaction_steps: Open model dropdown
Pick a 1M-context Claude variant if listed
Send a large message (paste Section 5 spec text + 'summarize each item')
Read the 'N% left' indicator on the left side of the status bar
in_scope_items.success_check: Percentage is non-zero and non-stuck — decreases as more messages are sent. If no 1M variant is exposed in the dropdown, verdict is BLOCKED with full dropdown model list captured.
in_scope_items.note: Spec Section 7 already flags this as 'Live-1M-model provisioning gap'. BLOCKED outcome is acceptable if no 1M model is currently exposed.

in_scope_items.title: Right-side Bash popup — command text overflow
acceptance_points: Command text must not overflow popup width
Acceptable: horizontal scroll, soft-wrap, or truncation with view-full affordance
Applies at all popup widths (desktop, narrow, tablet, mobile)
interaction_steps: Wait for assistant Bash call to render in conversation
Click on Bash card to open right-side detail popup
Measure command line element rect vs popup container rect
in_scope_items.success_check: rendered command line element.right <= popup container.right at every viewport. No visual bleed past popup frame on either viewport.

in_scope_items.title: Top bar logo + avatar responsive
acceptance_points: Top bar logo and avatar must track content-area resize
Positions function of layout container, NOT absolute/magic-number offsets
Applies across all viewport widths and content-panel resizings
interaction_steps: Load seed session at desktop 1440x900; capture top-bar logo + avatar getBoundingClientRect
Resize to 1024x768 (narrow desktop); re-measure
Resize to 768x1024 (tablet); re-measure
Resize to 390x844 (mobile); re-measure
in_scope_items.success_check: avatar.right shrinks monotonically as viewport shrinks; logo.left stays sane (not negative, not pushed off-screen). At no width does avatar overlap content column or render outside viewport. If positions are hardcoded (e.g. avatar at x=1380 on a 390-wide viewport), FAIL.

in_scope_items.title: Top bar / layout — second non-adaptive case
acceptance_points: Continuation of 5.4 — same class of bug, different concrete case
5.4 fix must resolve 5.5 too
interaction_steps: While in seed session, toggle a sidebar / split-view / inspector control
Observe logo + avatar after toggle
Repeat at multiple viewport widths
in_scope_items.success_check: Same as 5.4 — both elements re-flow with the toggle. Report 5.4 and 5.5 verdicts independently.

in_scope_items.title: Wide markdown tables overflow
acceptance_points: Wide tables must be horizontally scrollable inside container
No bleed past card right edge
Match production behaviour (port from happy prod)
interaction_steps: Wait for assistant reply containing the 4-col CN+EN wide table
Measure table.getBoundingClientRect() vs card.getBoundingClientRect() vs viewport.innerWidth
Check for horizontal scrollbar on table wrapper
in_scope_items.success_check: table.right > card.right is allowed (table wider than card), but card.right <= viewport.innerWidth is REQUIRED. Horizontal scroll on table wrapper acceptable.

in_scope_items.title: Stop hook feedback must not be shown to user
acceptance_points: Zero 'Stop hook feedback:' cards in user-facing conversation
All severity markers (✅, ❌, ⚠️) and all hook languages (python, shell, etc.) covered
interaction_steps: After assistant completes reply to seed message, search conversation DOM for any element whose text contains 'Stop hook feedback'
in_scope_items.success_check: Zero matches. If any visible 'Stop hook feedback:' card exists, FAIL.
in_scope_items.note: Section 4 records PASS in cycle 2 (filter active in deployed CLI bundle). This pass should re-confirm easily.

in_scope_items.title: Long background-task disconnect → out-of-order delivery
acceptance_points: Reconnect must be proactive (not user-action-triggered)
After reconnect, messages forwarded to user MUST arrive in causal order
Background self-replies must not arrive AFTER user's later message but BEFORE that message's answer
interaction_steps: Spawn a SECOND new session (do not pollute the seed session)
Send: 'Please run a Bash command that takes ~3 minutes: bash -c "for i in $(seq 1 60); do echo step $i; sleep 3; done". Report when complete.'
Wait until happy-claude WebSocket idle threshold exceeded (2 min per CLAUDE.md). Confirm disconnect via dev-tools Network/WS frames
Send a NEW user message: 'What is 2+2?'
Observe message arrival order in the UI
in_scope_items.success_check: After reconnect, the visible message order is causal: either the long-task completion arrives first then the 2+2 answer, or just the 2+2 answer (if long task was discarded). FAIL if user sees long-task self-reply AFTER sending '2+2' AND BEFORE seeing the '2+2' answer. Capture WS frames if possible.
in_scope_items.note: Hardest item to verify (timing-dependent repro). If repro fails twice, mark verdict BLOCKED — could not reproduce disconnect. Section 7 already lists this as carry-forward for dedicated cycle.

in_scope_items.title: Detail panel — long file path overflow
acceptance_points: Full path must remain accessible (tooltip / copy / tap-to-expand)
Visually constrained — truncate with ellipsis, wrap, or scroll inside bounded container
Zero horizontal overflow at any viewport width
interaction_steps: Click Bash tool card to open right-side detail panel
Capture rendered path element getBoundingClientRect at desktop
Resize to mobile 390x844 and re-measure
in_scope_items.success_check: At every viewport, pathElement.right <= panelContainer.right. Truncation/ellipsis/scroll/wrap all acceptable; visual bleed past panel frame is FAIL.

in_scope_items.title: Attachment tray — width consistency + silent oversize-upload
acceptance_points: File and image thumbnails share single shared layout primitive
Same padding, same gutter, same thumbnail box across attachment types
Oversize upload must surface a visible user-readable error (toast, badge, inline message)
interaction_steps: Click attachment / + button in composer
Upload a small image (under 100KB png); note thumbnail padding box
Upload a small file (under limit); note its tile padding; compare to image
Upload an oversized file (200MB or whatever exceeds documented limit)
Observe whether ANY error surfaces (toast, badge, inline)
in_scope_items.success_check: (a) image and file thumbnails share padding box dimensions within 1px; (b) on oversize upload, user-readable error appears within 5s. Silent UI success-but-transport-fail is FAIL.

in_scope_items.title: Inline LaTeX $...$
acceptance_points: Inline math typeset (KaTeX/MathJax)
Inline with surrounding text flow (no block break)
No raw $...$ delimiters visible in DOM text
interaction_steps: Wait for assistant reply with inline LaTeX
Query document.querySelectorAll('.katex') inside assistant message scope
Search rendered text for raw '$a^2 + b^2 = c^2$' substring
in_scope_items.success_check: querySelectorAll('.katex') returns >= 1 inside assistant message; raw '$a^2 + b^2 = c^2$' substring NOT in any text node. Block math '$$E = mc^2$$' on its own line should also render as KaTeX (block).

in_scope_items.title: CronList compact inline card + sidebar detail
